description: This file defines the ProjectAdminUserRole class, which extends AbstractUserRole and manages user role permissions related to projects, customers, and employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve accessible IDs for different entities based on user permissions.

classes.name: ProjectAdminUserRole
classes.description: A role class that grants access to project, customer, and employee data for users with project admin privileges.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities (employees, projects, customers) accessible to the user based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs if the INCLUDE_EMPLOYEE permission is granted.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Provides project IDs accessible to the user as a project admin.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns customer IDs that the project admin has access to.
